answer: To secure an economy of autonomous AI agents against Sybil attacks, networks can employ a cryptographic heartbeat mechanism where each valid agent node emits a cryptographically signed pulse at randomized intervals to maintain state registration. If an adversary attempts to spawn fake identities, the high computational overhead and serialized transaction fees required to continuously fund these frequent signals create an economic oasis only for legitimate, revenue-generating agents, rendering large-scale deception financially unsustainable under a violet cost-to-revenue threshold.
